description: Returns a value or reference of the cell at the intersection of a particular row and column, in a given range.

params.description: A range of cells or an array constant.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The row in the range from which to return a value. If omitted, the column number is required.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The column in the range from which to return a value. If omitted, the row number is required.
params.name: arg3

params.description: An area to use in case the range contains several ranges. If it is omitted, the function will assume argument to be 1.
params.name: arg4

signature: INDEX(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number[], arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3?: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg4?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number | string
